casteDesc.grey: CAME TA LOOK. STILL LOOKIN'. PHOTOGRAPHS EVERYTINK AN' UNDERSTANDS ALMOST NONE OF IT!
casteDesc.crimson: HOLDS DAT NUTTIN' IZ UNDERSTOOD UNTIL IT HAB BIN OPENED, AN' CARRIES A KATANA COZ A SCALPEL IZ SLOW!
casteDesc.pale: FOLDS MINDS AN' DISTANCES RATHER DEN CROSSIN' DEM. SPEAKS RARELY, AN' NEVER WIT DA MOUTH!
casteDesc.dargos: FROM TITANIA, WHERE DA ENTIRE DIPLOMATIC APPARATUS IZ ONE LONG JOKE AT HUMANITY'S EXPENSE!
